params.body:
The category owners on the Deliveries page were typed email addresses. A typo or someone who had left was accepted silently, and a sector could only go to one person. Owners are now people and groups on the team, picked rather than typed.

**Groups on the team** (`packages/core/team-groups.mjs`)
- A group is a name plus user ids, kept in `store/team-groups.json` (`TW_TEAM_GROUPS_PATH` in tests) like the category owners.
- `GET /config/team-groups` is for admins and editors and returns the groups plus the members to pick from. `POST` is admin only and saves the whole set.
- A group keeps its id when renamed. A name can't be empty or used twice, and a member must be on the team.
- Someone removed from the team (or with an invitation not yet accepted) drops out of every group when it is read.

**Owners are references**
- `user:<id>` or `group:<id>`. `setCategoryOwners` refuses anything that doesn't resolve to a person or group on the team.
- An address saved under the old format is read as the person with that address, so a setting saved before keeps working.

**The relay** (`/site/commitments`)
- Each read carries `owner` and `suggested_owner` resolved to a name (or `gone: true` when the owner has left), plus `mine`: whether it is the caller's, directly or through a group. The response includes the directory for the pickers.
- `{take: true}` sets the read to drafting with the caller as owner.
- A read still due may be owned by a group. Once it moves past due, a group owner (or no owner) is replaced by whoever moved it, so a read being written always has a person on it.
- An owner that isn't on the team is refused with a 400.
- gentells.com is unchanged: it stores the owner as an opaque string.

`docs/design/customers-and-seams.md` describes the new behaviour.

Tests: `test/commitments-relay.test.mjs` (15 of 15: groups, references, the old-address migration, take-up, group to person, refusal, the page-not-data case). The full suite passes apart from the 6 report-render tests that need `pdftoppm`.
params.title: Owners are people and groups on the team, not typed addresses
